title: Standing-Order Cushion Line — Units, Months and Card Charge (PAP Supply Replenishment Program)
content:
## Charge rule

A standing-order cushion line of the Self-Pay Supply Subscription, PAP Supply Replenishment Program, repeats the standing order: the line carries the latest standing-order cushion line's units per month for the schedule's maximum months per shipment, priced at the item's cash price less the subscription discount of the schedule, rounded to the cent half up for the line.

**Discount scope.** On the Self-Pay Supply Subscription the schedule's subscription discount applies to every self-pay item line of the subscription, standing-order lines, branch purchases and add-on items alike, and is rounded to the cent half up per line; a shipping charge is not an item line and takes no discount, its amount following the shipping rules.

**Cash prices.** 44.00 for a full face cushion (A7031), 29.00 for a nasal cushion (A7032) and 19.00 for a pair of nasal pillows (A7033). The cushion item is the one of the recorded mask style.

**Order validity.** A line never covers months past the supply order's validity, counted as the order's validity months less the whole months since the order date, less one for the month in progress. The months covered are therefore the lower of the schedule's maximum months per shipment and the months left on the order, never below zero.

## Definitions

- **Standing-order history:** the enrollment's self-pay cushion lines that went out by ground; lines collected at a branch are purchases outside the standing order.
- **Latest standing-order cushion line:** the newest of those lines by ship date.
- **Its units per month:** its units divided by the months it covered, the months being the whole calendar months from its ship date to its covered-through date, plus one for the month it began in.
- **Units shipped:** the units per month multiplied by the months covered, rounded down to a whole unit.
- **Amount charged:** the units shipped multiplied by the cash price, less the subscription discount, rounded to the cent half up.
- **Covered-through date:** the day before the same day of the month that lies the months covered after the ship date.

## Worked example (hypothetical; the subscription discount taken as 10 percent)

Recorded style nasal. Latest standing-order cushion line: 6 nasal cushions shipped 10 January, covered through 9 April — 3 months, so 2 a month. Order validity 12 months, order dated 5 whole months ago: 12 less 5 less 1 leaves 6 months; the schedule maximum of 3 is lower, so 3 months. Units: 2 multiplied by 3 is 6. Amount: 6 multiplied by 29.00 is 174.00; less 10 percent is 156.60. Shipping 10 May, the line covers through 9 August.

*Order nearly used up:* the same patient with an order dated 10 whole months ago has 12 less 10 less 1, which is 1 month left; the line covers 1 month and carries 2 units, 58.00 less 10 percent, 52.20.
